input.quote: (j) This Agreement constitutes the entire Agreement between the parties with respect to its subject matter, and this Agreement supersedes all prior understandings, representations, negotiations and communications between the parties, oral and written.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance provision anywhere: searches for "insurance"/coverage return nothing, and § 20 General Matters (p0135-p0147, p0149-p0150) runs from time-of-essence through entire agreement without an insurance covenant. Garman nonetheless converts and processes Sparkling's data (§ 4(b), p0042) and performs installation, training and implementation work at our Authorized Locations, which is walk-away territory under the rule. We therefore insert a short insurance paragraph at the preferred level (CGL USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, E&O USD 2,000,000, cyber and privacy USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Sparkling, and statutory workers' compensation, with certificates on request), and can settle at the fallback of E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber USD 2,000,000.

mappings.element: Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
Commercial general liability coverage is at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.
If Vendor processes Customer Data, cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 5,000,000.
Vendor maintains workers' compensation coverage as required by law.
Vendor provides certificates of insurance on request.

proposal.summary: Insert Garman insurance covenant in General Matters
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Garman converts and processes our data and attends our locations, so we need a standard insurance covenant; we have added our preferred limits (CGL USD 1M/2M, E&O USD 2M, cyber USD 5M where our data is processed, statutory workers' compensation) plus certificates on request. We can fall back to E&O USD 1M and cyber USD 2M if limits are an issue.

ops.text: (k) Garman shall maintain commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Garman processes any data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Sparkling, cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.
